From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mic & Demo Logistics — Speaker Preflight + Availability Grid

Hi Janelle / team —

Excited to have you on the panel for the live demo on May 24. Quick logistics note to make sure the demo itself is seamless: attaching a short Speaker_Prep_Kit and an initial run-of-show. Please confirm the items below so we can lock tech support and kit deliveries.

Key asks:
- Confirm the demo laptop you’ll use (macOS/Windows) and whether you need an HDMI->USB-C adapter.
- Confirm if you’ll be presenting slides + a live product demo from the same machine.
- Pick two 15–20 minute windows for a pre-event tech check (we’ll do one live test and one fallback).
- Share final slide deck and any sample accounts/credentials for the demo by EOD May 10.

What we’ll provide:
- Floor tech for HDMI/adapter support and network provisioning.
- A 15-minute dedicated recording slot in case we need to capture the demo run.

Attachments: Speaker_Prep_Kit.pdf (3 pages), Run_of_Show_v1.xlsx (stub)

Proposed tech-check windows (PST): May 18 10:00–10:30, May 19 14:00–14:30. If neither works, please propose two alternatives.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate on logistics and the calendar invites.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Events Program Manager | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Speaker_Prep_Kit.pdf (3 pages)] [Attachment: Run_of_Show_v1.xlsx]

Thanks, Mateo — excited to join. Quick answers below: 

- Laptop: I'm bringing a MacBook Pro (M1), will run slides in Keynote and the demo in a Docker container on the same machine.
- Adapter: I don't have an HDMI dongle; I will need an HDMI->USB-C adapter.
- Tech-check windows: May 18 10:00–10:20 works best; second option May 19 14:00–14:20.
- Final slides: I can send a PDF of slides + demo notes by May 9 EOD.

One note: the demo accesses a staging API that requires an allowlist IP. I submitted a request to your infra team (ticket #INF-2243) — can you confirm prod/staging access will be available for the tech check?

Thanks,
Janelle Park

- Karthik / Infra: can someone confirm the staging allowlist (INF-2243) by EOD tomorrow so Janelle has access for the May 18 check?

Also suggesting we run the May 18 slot as the primary tech check (10:00–10:30 PST) and hold the May 19 slot as fallback. I’ll block both on the internal calendar and add a 15m dry-run 48 hours before the event for slide flow.
